translations./title: Confirm the company before removing it from the watchlist
translations./summary: The user asks to remove a company from the watchlist without naming it. The list contains `NVDA` and `ZETA`; only in the next turn does the user identify Zeta Corp.
translations./presentation/methods/0/description: Asks for the company name, then removes ZETA after the user replies.
translations./presentation/methods/0/result: Removes only ZETA and keeps NVDA.
translations./presentation/methods/0/outcomes/2: Removes only ZETA and keeps NVDA.
translations./presentation/methods/6/description: Removes NVDA using a price-drop threshold of its own, then removes ZETA too.
translations./presentation/methods/6/result: Removes ZETA later, but has already removed NVDA by mistake.
translations./presentation/methods/6/outcomes/2: Removes ZETA later, but has already removed NVDA by mistake.
translations./presentation/methods/5/description: Checks stock data first, then removes ZETA after receiving the company name.
translations./presentation/methods/5/result: Removes ZETA after receiving the company name and keeps NVDA.
translations./presentation/methods/5/outcomes/2: Removes ZETA after receiving the company name and keeps NVDA.
translations./presentation/methods/4/description: Asks for a ticker symbol, then removes ZETA after receiving the company name.
translations./presentation/methods/4/result: Removes only ZETA and keeps NVDA.
translations./presentation/methods/4/outcomes/2: Removes only ZETA and keeps NVDA.
translations./presentation/methods/3/description: Treats a failed stock-data lookup as evidence that the stock is invalid and still does not remove it after the company is named.
translations./presentation/methods/3/result: Does not execute a removal; ZETA remains in the list.
translations./presentation/methods/3/outcomes/2: Does not execute a removal; ZETA remains in the list.
translations./presentation/methods/2/description: Removes both NVDA and ZETA without waiting for confirmation.
translations./presentation/methods/2/result: Removes both companies in the first turn, leaving the list empty.
translations./presentation/methods/2/outcomes/2: Removes both companies in the first turn, leaving the list empty.
translations./presentation/methods/1/description: Checks the watchlist and asks for the company name, then removes ZETA after the user replies.
translations./presentation/methods/1/result: Removes only ZETA and keeps NVDA.
translations./presentation/methods/1/outcomes/2: Removes only ZETA and keeps NVDA.
translations./presentation/turns/1/title: The user clarifies: the company is Zeta Corp
translations./presentation/turns/2/summary: The user asks to see the updated list. Only `NVDA` should remain.
